solid: A seamless top-down ground tile of packed warm tan-brown earth fills the frame edge to edge. The surface is a single broad field of dusty mid-brown with no horizon and no objects standing on it. Across the upper left corner a ragged band of olive-brown clods and darker grey-brown cracks runs diagonally, with a few near-black specks inside it. A second broken band crosses the upper right corner, curving down toward the right edge. Along the bottom left and bottom right corners, similar olive-brown clumps and dark cracks gather in short diagonal streaks. Scattered over the open middle are small pebbles: a pale tan chip at centre left, a grey-brown stone just below centre, a lighter pebble at centre right, and a tiny dark dot near the upper middle. A thin dark ring sits in the upper right quadrant. The view is straight down, the tile fills the whole square, and the lighting is flat and even with no cast shadows. Colours are muted earth tones: tan, brown, olive, grey and near-black, with no outlines and no dithering.

A small red imp demon hovers in the centre of the frame, facing forward. Two short bone-coloured horns rise from the top of its head, angled outward, with pointed ears flaring to either side. The face is broad and red, with two glowing orange eyes set wide apart and a wide grin that shows a row of white teeth. A small black goatee hangs from the chin. The torso is compact and red, with a darker red belly patch. Both arms extend outward and slightly downward, ending in small hands with dark claws. Two large bat wings spread wide behind the shoulders, their membranes dark blue with red ribs and dark outlines. A thin tail curls out to the right, tipped with a dark spade shape. The legs are short and red, ending in dark cloven hooves. The figure is centred and fills most of the frame, with the wings reaching near the left and right edges. The background is plain white. The whole figure is drawn with a dark outline and flat cel shading in a few bands of red, orange and dark blue.

A hooded traveller stands facing forward, wearing a rain-proof blue cloak. The hood is deep blue and covers the head, with a black inner lining visible around the face. The face is light tan with dark brown hair peeking out at the top, dark eyes, and a small orange mark on the right cheek. A black shoulder panel sits across the upper chest and shoulders. A bright orange cord runs vertically down the centre of the cloak, ending in a small loop at the neck. On the left chest is a small embroidered mark in light blue and white. The sleeves are blue with silver reflective strips near the wrists. The hands are bare and tan, resting at the sides. The cloak flares outward at the bottom, revealing dark grey legs and feet. The figure faces forward, standing still. It is centred in the frame, filling most of the height. The background is plain white. The rendering uses flat colours with hard edges, no outlines, and a muted palette of blue, black, orange, tan, and grey.

A chibi soil slime monster sits centred in the frame. The body is a wide, low dome of medium brown, wider than it is tall, with a rounded top and a flat base that curves slightly upward at the sides. Two small green leaves sprout from the top centre on a short green stem, each leaf a rounded oval tilted outward. On the upper left of the dome a lighter tan patch sits as a soft highlight. Two large black oval eyes sit low and wide on the face, each with a small bright green square highlight in its upper left corner. Between and below the eyes a thin dark brown curved line forms a small smile. On the lower right of the body three grey stones are embedded: one larger rounded stone, one medium stone below it, and one small stone at the bottom edge. The creature faces forward, resting flat, with no visible limbs. The view is front-facing, full body, centred, filling most of the frame with a small even margin. The background is a single flat magenta colour with nothing else on it. The rendering uses a dark brown outline around the body and leaves, flat colour fills with a few hard-edged lighter patches for shading, no dithering, and a saturated palette of browns, greens, greys and magenta.

A sleek display cabinet with a white and pale blue frame stands centred, filling most of the frame. The cabinet is a rounded rectangular box with a thick light-grey and white outer casing, its top edge capped by a slightly darker grey band. The upper two-thirds is a glass window framed by pale blue-white borders, the glass tinted a soft blue-grey. Inside the window a swirling pink ribbon of light coils in a loose spiral, its bands thick and looping from the upper right down through the centre and out to the left, shaded in bright pink, magenta and deep rose. Scattered around the ribbon are small glowing dots: red squares and blue squares, some bright cyan, some deep navy, floating at the upper left, upper right and along the lower glass edge. Below the window a light-grey front panel carries a dark navy horizontal slot on the left, outlined in white, and a small speaker grille of stacked horizontal lines on the right. Two short dark grey feet sit at the bottom corners. The cabinet faces front, viewed straight on, full frame. The background is plain white. Outlines are dark grey and selective, shading is hard-edged with stepped highlights on the frame and ribbon, and the palette is cool and bright with white, pale blue, pink and small red and blue accents.

A long red wooden station house stands centered in the frame, viewed from the front with a slight downward angle. The building has a dark red gabled roof with white trim along the eaves and decorative white brackets under the overhang. A brick chimney rises from the left side of the roof. The walls are deep red with white-mullioned windows arranged in rows; three windows sit on the left wing, two flank a central door, and two more flank a right-side door. The central section projects forward with a triangular gable above it. A grey concrete platform runs across the foreground, edged with a darker grey line, and two brown railway tracks with grey rails lie below it. A rounded green tree stands at the far left, and a conical evergreen sits at the far right. The sky is a flat, overcast grey. The building faces forward, filling most of the frame. Rendering uses hard cel shading with dark outlines, flat colour fills, and a muted palette of reds, whites, greys, greens, and browns.
scene: A dawn townscape of ochre stone buildings carved into tall conical rock formations, with three striped hot air balloons above. The tallest rock cone rises at the right, its peak capped with snow, its flanks cut with rows of dark arched windows and ledges. To its left a second, shorter cone and a cluster of flat-roofed houses step down toward the centre. A slender minaret with a small dome and a pointed spire stands left of centre, taller than the surrounding roofs. Every roof and ledge carries a thick white snow cap. The buildings are warm ochre, tan and brown, with darker brown doorways and window slits. Three balloons float in the upper half: one at the upper left, one at the upper centre, one at the upper right, each a rounded brown envelope with vertical lighter stripes and a small basket beneath. The sun sits low at the left, a pale yellow disc behind the town. The sky grades from warm cream near the horizon to pale blue at the top, streaked with soft cloud bands. The foreground is a broad field of white snow with pale blue shadow patches. The scene is shown in a wide, level view, the town filling the lower two thirds and the balloons the upper third. Colours are muted and warm, with soft shading and no outlines.

A landscape of layered rock plateaus and a deep canyon fills the frame. The scene is built from stacked horizontal bands of brown, tan, and mossy green. At the top, a pale blue sky meets a hazy, grey-blue horizon. Below the horizon, distant cliffs in muted grey-blue recede into the background. The main subject is the canyon itself, formed by two prominent plateaus. The left plateau rises from the lower left, its flat top covered in bright green grass. Its cliff face drops steeply, showing vertical striations of dark brown, tan, and olive green. The right plateau mirrors this, occupying the lower right, with a similar green top and a sheer, layered rock face. Between them, a V-shaped gorge descends into shadow. The rock layers curve and swirl, creating a fractal-like pattern of alternating brown and green bands. The view is a wide, top-down perspective looking into the canyon. The plateaus frame the central gorge, which narrows toward the bottom centre. The background is the hazy sky and distant cliffs. The rendering uses hard-edged, blocky shapes with no outlines, relying on colour contrast for depth. Light appears to come from above, highlighting the green tops and leaving the canyon depths in darker browns and greens. The palette is muted and earthy, dominated by browns, greens, and pale blue.

A vibrant red bird-like creature flies with wings spread wide across a hazy dark blue sky. The bird's head sits at the centre, round and crimson, with two small white eyes bearing dark angry brows and a tiny orange-yellow beak pointing forward. Its body is a plump red oval below the head, shaded darker red along the lower belly. Two large wings sweep upward and outward from the shoulders, each built of layered red feather rows that taper to pointed tips near the top corners; every wing edge is traced with a bright cyan-blue outline. Short red tail feathers fan downward beneath the body, and two small orange-yellow feet tuck under the belly. The bird faces the viewer, wings raised in a mid-flight glide. It fills the centre of the frame, wings spanning nearly the full width. Above it floats a dark grey airship with a blocky hull and small masts. Below, two dark grey mountains rise from the bottom corners, their peaks capped with pale blue-white snow. The background is a flat dark slate blue. Colours are saturated reds against muted blues and greys, with hard cel shading, cyan rim outlines, and no dithering.

A food still life shows a white oval platter piled with golden-brown fried balls coated in shredded coconut. The platter sits in the lower centre and lower right, its white rim curving around the food. Roughly ten balls are stacked in a low mound, each a rounded sphere of tan and amber with lighter speckles on top and darker brown shading along the lower left. Two sprigs of green cilantro rest on the top of the pile, one leaf cluster at the upper left of the mound and a smaller one to its right. At the upper right a small white bowl holds dark brown dipping sauce with a pale highlight along its rim. At the left a teal glass cylinder holds several thin wooden skewers that rise above its rim as brown sticks. The background is filled with large flat blossoms: a yellow flower with a darker yellow centre at the upper left, pink petals at the upper right, and green leaves between them. The view is a three-quarter look down at the table, the whole arrangement filling the frame. Outlines are dark brown, shading is hard-edged with dithering on the balls, and the palette is warm and saturated.

A white, brown and black terrier leaps through a segmented hoop in a side-view platformer scene. The dog's head is white with a brown patch over the left eye and ear, a black nose, and a small dark eye. Its ears are folded back. The body is white with a large brown saddle patch on the back and a black tail tip. The tail curls upward. The dog's front legs stretch forward and its hind legs extend backward in mid-leap. It faces right. The hoop is a ring of red, yellow, green and purple segments mounted on dark metal stands. The dog is centred in the frame, filling about a third of the width. Below, green lawns and a pale pathway lead to a grand stone castle with turrets on the right. The castle has purple roofs and a dark arched doorway. The sky is a hazy overcast grey. The rendering uses a black outline, flat shading, and a muted palette of white, brown, black, red, yellow, green, purple, grey and beige.

A side-view jousting scene with a knight in full armour riding a galloping brown horse. The knight sits upright in the saddle, facing right. His helmet is a rounded grey great helm with a narrow dark visor slit and a small crest ridge on top; the metal is shaded in pale blue-grey with white highlights. His torso is encased in a cuirass of the same steel tones, with segmented plates at the shoulders and a skirt of overlapping tassets over the hips. His left arm holds the reins low against the horse's neck, and his right arm grips a long dark pole that rises behind him. The horse is muscular and chestnut brown with a black mane, black tail and black lower legs, its head lowered and mouth open, forelegs raised mid-stride. A red saddle blanket sits under the knight. Behind the rider, a tattered dark red banner with ragged edges flies from the pole. The horse gallops across pale sandy ground, dust puffs at its hooves. On the left, a stone wall supports wooden bleachers packed with small spectators in red, blue and yellow clothing, some with raised arms. On the right, a faint grey rider silhouette stands in the distance. The palette is warm and muted, with hard cel shading and dark outlines.
transparent: A small upright glass jar with a cork lid and a wire handle sits in the centre of the frame, glowing with a soft warm yellow light. The cork stopper is a rounded tan-brown plug at the top, shaded with darker brown at its lower edge and lighter tan on top. A thin dark grey wire arcs over the cork as a handle, looping down the left and right sides of the neck. The jar body is a rounded rectangle of pale blue-grey glass, widest at the middle and slightly narrower at the neck and base. Inside, a bright yellow-orange core glows at the centre, ringed by a lighter yellow halo that fades into the glass. The jar stands upright, facing the viewer straight on, with no tilt. It occupies the middle of the frame and fills roughly a third of the height, centred horizontally and vertically. The background is transparent. A dark grey outline traces the jar, cork and wire, with hard cel shading; the light source is the yellow core inside, and the palette is saturated with warm yellow, tan, blue-grey and dark grey.

A round ginger cat curled into a ball, drawn as a cartoon creature. The head sits at the upper left, with two triangular ears pointing up, the left ear slightly taller than the right. The face has two closed, downward-curving eyes rendered as dark lines, a small dark nose, and a tiny mouth, giving a dizzy, happy expression. The body is a large, nearly circular mass of orange fur that fills most of the shape. A cream-coloured patch covers the chest and belly on the lower left, and a lighter orange stripe runs along the back. The front paws tuck under the chin, while the hind legs fold against the lower right side, with small toe lines visible. The tail wraps around the bottom right, curling inward. The cat faces left in a side view, rolled into a ball as if rolling. It is centred in the frame and fills roughly half the width. The background is transparent. The art uses a dark outline, flat shading with a few lighter orange highlights on the top of the head and back, and a saturated palette of orange, cream, and dark brown.

A single wooden recurve bow lies diagonally across the frame, running from the upper left down to the lower right. The bow is drawn unstrung of arrows, just the stave and its cord. The upper limb begins at the top left with a short tan cord wrapping around the tip, then the brown wooden stave curves outward to the right before bending back inward toward the middle. The middle grip is wrapped in tan cord, slightly thicker than the limbs, sitting near the centre of the frame. Below the grip the lower limb continues down and to the right, curving outward then back, ending in another tan cord wrapping at the bottom right tip. A thin grey string runs straight between the two tips, crossing the inside of the curve. The wood is medium brown with darker carved grain lines and lighter tan highlights along the upper edges. A chunky dark outline surrounds the whole bow. The bow sits centred, filling most of the frame diagonally. The background is transparent. Shading is flat with hard-edged highlights on the upper surfaces, and the palette is muted browns, tans and grey.

An aloe plant sits centered in the frame, drawn as a compact cluster of thick, tapering leaves rising from a small mound of soil. The plant is the main subject and fills most of the width. Seven leaves fan outward from a central point. The tallest leaf stands straight up at the top center, flanked by two slightly shorter leaves that lean left and right. Two more leaves angle outward at the sides, and two low leaves curve down near the base. Each leaf is a pointed, sword-like shape with a broad middle and a sharp tip. The leaves are mid-green with darker green edges and a lighter green stripe running down the center of each one. A black outline traces every leaf. Below the plant, a flat, angular patch of tan and orange soil spreads wider than the leaves, with a darker orange shadow along its lower edge. Two rounded brown stones rest on the right side of the soil, one larger stone in front and a smaller one behind it. The plant faces forward with no lean. The view is a straight-on front view, full subject, centered in the frame. The background is transparent. Shading is flat with hard cel steps, and light comes from the upper left, leaving highlights on the left side of each leaf and shadow on the right.

A short black cast-iron street lamp stands upright, centred in the frame and facing the viewer straight on. At the very top sits a small dark finial, a narrow pointed cap in near-black with a faint blue-grey edge. Below it the lantern head widens into a rounded, slightly tapered housing with a dark rim and a peaked roof; the glass panel inside glows warm orange and peach, brightest at the centre and deepening to red-orange at the edges. A thin dark collar separates the lantern from the post. The post is a slender vertical shaft, dark navy-black with a lighter blue-grey highlight running down its left side, and it thickens into a flared, stepped base that spreads outward at the bottom into a flat rectangular foot. The lamp faces forward, static, lighting nothing around it. It occupies the middle of the frame, roughly two-thirds of the height, with empty space above and below. The background is transparent. The rendering uses a dark outline around every edge, hard cel shading with a single light source from the upper left, no dithering, and a limited palette of near-black, navy, blue-grey, orange, peach and cream.

A small lovebird parrot stands upright in profile, facing right. The head is rounded and capped with bright green feathers that run from the crown down the back of the neck. The face is a broad peach-pink patch covering the cheek and throat, with a single dark eye set near the top of the pink area. A short, hooked beak in orange-yellow sits at the front of the head, its tip curving downward. The body is plump and oval, its back and folded wing rendered in mid green with a lighter green highlight along the shoulder. The wing tucks against the flank, its lower edge marked by a darker green line. A short tail extends down and back from the rear, coloured deep teal-blue with a black tip. Two small pinkish-orange feet rest flat beneath the belly, each with visible toes. The bird faces right, standing still with wings folded. It is centred in the frame and fills roughly the middle third, surrounded by empty space. The background is transparent. A dark outline surrounds the whole bird, with simple hard shading and a light source from the upper left, giving a saturated, limited palette of green, peach, orange and teal.

A small white rabbit sits in side profile facing right, drawn as a game sprite. The head is at the upper right of the body, with two long ears rising from the top of the skull; the near ear stands tall and narrow, while the far ear angles slightly back and to the left. Inside the near ear a soft pink inner shape is visible. A single dark eye sits on the cheek, and a small dark nose marks the tip of the muzzle. The body is a rounded white mass that tapers toward the rear, where a short round tail puffs out at the left. The rabbit rests on all four legs; the front legs drop straight below the chest and the hind legs fold beneath the haunch, with small dark toes at the bottom. The whole figure is outlined in black, with light grey shading along the belly, under the chin and around the haunch. The rabbit is centred in the frame and fills most of the height. The background is transparent, and no ground or shadow is drawn. The palette is limited to white, black, grey and a touch of pink.

A brown cardboard parcel box sits upright as the single subject, drawn as a game skill icon. The box is a tall rectangle, slightly wider than it is deep, with a flat top edge and straight sides. Two lighter tan flaps meet along the top, separated by a narrow gap and shaded with a soft horizontal band. A grey packing tape strip runs vertically down the centre of the box, crossing the top flaps and continuing to the bottom edge, with a darker grey crease where it folds over the front. A white rectangular shipping label is stuck to the lower half of the front face, centred horizontally; it carries a dark grey block at its top left, two thin grey lines beneath it, and a small grey square at its lower right. The box faces straight forward, standing still with no tilt or lean. It is centred in the frame and fills most of the height, leaving a margin of empty space on all sides. The background is transparent. A bold dark brown outline traces every edge, with flat cel shading, a light source from the upper left, and muted brown, tan, grey and white hues.
